test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 9 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'BREAK’ is written as 'BSEBK' and 'FAST' is written as 'FBSU'. How will 'BREAKFAST' be written in that language?
solution:
Here, the alphabets and their positions are shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a72a30b8cfc6309b36506bcbabb6647d5379494fca9023856cca8a5a79bf064f.png] 

**Logic:** The even position letters are increased by 1 and odd letters are as it is. 

 'BREAK’ is written as 'BSEBK' 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a27bede6b400d3dbd8abf61defd3590a0f44f485797a4f5efec2c3778a8810c.png] 

And,

'FAST' is written as 'FBSU'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e4137fcf4dfe61639075661c1c4792fd67f4ebd6540e0ad2190c0ed43184699.png] 

Similarly,

'BREAKFAST' is written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e31dc347c547dbac76971082eabc439f60cda46c6d6fb14a2cb8e2fe8d6fee1.png] 

Hence, the code language is **'BSEBKGATT'** for the given word.
